title: Combate · arcano
prompt: Create a crisp detailed pixel-art sprite animation sheet for Agents Bar, matching silver-blue, warm gold, deep navy medieval fantasy materials. TRUE frame-by-frame shapes changing, no merely translated or recolored copies. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, sixteen equal square cells, one animation per row, four successive frames left to right. Transparent alpha-zero background. No text, no labels, no frames, no checkerboard. Each cell has 15% empty padding on every edge; keep the whole effect inside its cell, with constant scale. No characters. Row1 analysis: gold angular rune outline, rune opens into eight pointed compass, rotating fragmented rune, scattered runic dots. Row2 lightning: thin branching blue bolt, thick forked white-blue bolt, jagged residual arcs, fading blue sparks. Row3 reward: small gold star, gold star burst and coin shapes, wide shower of coins, falling small glitter. Row4 defeat: small dark purple crack, eclipse ring shatters, shards of violet shadow expand, tiny dissolving dark shards.
